title: Complete cargo orientation/setup with bounded fixture progress
acceptance_criteria: Resolved oriented queries and replacement drops preserve collision, authority, ownership, contents and production physics.
Permission-2 cargo/yaw commands provide the complete documented owner setup through existing loaded-frame and transfer services.
Fixture-only progress reports actual names/tick ages with bounded state, honest overflow/outcomes, cleanup and a proven native hook.
Fresh full JVM, focused native and full native evidence has actual counts and safe shutdown; genuine failures remain failed.
manual_steps: After technical readiness, use this worktree's normal development launch and a disposable world. As a permission-2 operator with a live controlled body and loaded clear space, run /ms14 shuttle_fixture build; retain its ship ID.

Enter the front airlock using normal movement/jumping. Run /ms14 shuttle_fixture cargo <ship-id> aboard: one five-unit water jug should appear near the body without overwriting hands or carrier inventory.

Examine and pick up the jug using configured controls, then Drop active hand (default Q). Selection/outlines should agree with the oriented physical-profile proxy; contents should remain five units. The proxy is not the exact mesh.

Run /ms14 shuttle_fixture yaw <ship-id> 0.4 once; repeat query, pickup and drop as the cabin turns. Replacements should use the current actor-frame world basis without loss. This is a rad/s velocity delta, not an angle or pilot control. Do not test high-speed impacts or pitch/roll.

checks.rationale: One full JVM run includes the 16 geometry/profile/orientation tests plus six new progress-state tests; expected 3314 total, report actual. This preserves all R6 JVM coverage without a later run overwriting earlier receipt-bound XML. Compile every fixture. Stop on failure.
